svg.title: DFCuts — sixteen logo concepts
svg.desc: Comparison sheet of sixteen original vector logo directions.

g.text: 16 new constructions: folded stock, extracted corners, interlocking letters and cutting channels.
A small offcut makes the C feel freshly cut.
A folded strip becomes a continuous letter junction.
An extracted corner is part of the identity.
A compact die-cut block with a stepped counter.
Two offset loops share one deliberate cutting gap.
An F spine and a C return lock into one shape.
A rising paper ribbon folds into the initials.
The lifted edge becomes the opening of the C.
An offset internal corner is the identifying cut.
A squared counter joins the D, F and C logic.
Two curved returns meet around a short F bar.
A hinged cut through a chamfered outline.
A button-sized disc with an offset gauge cut.
A curved strip folds inward to suggest the F.
A pocket-shaped counter opens through the circle.
Two offset segments reveal a clean cutting channel.
Editable SVG paths • Transparent masters + rendered PNGs • Monochrome first
